pair.title: Smart Energy PLAT
pair.intro: Sign in with the same account and password you use in the Smart Energy PLAT app. Homey will then list the battery packs linked to that account so you can add one or more.
pair.linktext: Use your CFE Smart Energy PLAT cloud account.

pair_prepare.title: Set up batteries in Smart Energy PLAT first
pair_prepare.intro: Homey reads packs from your Smart Energy PLAT cloud account. Download the app, add each battery by scanning the barcode, connect it to Wi-Fi, and then continue here.
pair_prepare.step_app: Download the Smart Energy PLAT app and create or sign in to your account.
pair_prepare.step_scan: Add each battery in the app by scanning the barcode on the pack.
pair_prepare.step_wifi: Connect each battery to Wi-Fi using the steps below.
pair_prepare.step_homey: When the packs are online in the app, you can add them to Homey.
pair_prepare.wifi_step_1: After adding the battery to the app
pair_prepare.wifi_step_2: Tap Configure Wi-Fi for the battery you want to connect
pair_prepare.wifi_step_3: Hold down the reset button for about 3 seconds, until the status light starts blinking
pair_prepare.wifi_step_4: Follow the app to connect the battery to Wi-Fi

modbus_pair.title: Connect to Modbus
modbus_pair.intro: Using Modbus to connect to your device requires you to have Modbus TCP enabled for your device and a ethernet cable connected.
modbus_pair.linktext: Click here to read more about connecting your modbus device to your network.
modbus_pair.solarman_serial: Serial number of your Solarman dongle

connection_type.title: Select your connection type
connection_type.solarman: Select this when you are using the Solarman dongle to connect Homey to your device.
connection_type.modbus: Select this when you are using a Modbus to TCP adapter to connect Homey to your device
